title: processkit MCP request rejection
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error response of the MCP server for a request it does not execute (mcp-context-serving@v1 PK-MCP-081): a request limit, an unknown tool, or an unparsable message. At most 8192 bytes. Tool failures are tool results with isError true instead.

id.description: The request id; null when it cannot be read.

code.description: -32700 unparsable message, -32600 request too large, -32602 unknown tool, -32000 concurrency limit, -32001 request timeout.
